descriptions.normal: A vegetable salad. Not just steamed potatoes and fresh vegetables, but also a hard-boiled egg to top it off. Satisfying to both the eyes and stomach.
descriptions.suspicious: A vegetable salad. Regrettably, it seems the best time to plate the potatoes and boiled eggs was missed.
descriptions.delicious: A vegetable salad. Fresh, light and varied. You'd never get tired of eating this, even if you had to eat it for the rest of your life.

effectTexts.normal: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 9% for 300s.
effectTexts.suspicious: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 6% for 300s.
effectTexts.delicious: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 12% for 300s.
